notes: Read all 185 source lines with line numbers before porting. Covered: the react/react-dom/cn imports (L1-10), the PopoverAlign/PopoverSide type aliases (L12-13), the full PopoverProps interface incl. open/onClose/anchorRef/side/align/sideOffset/className/ariaLabel/children with their doc comments (L15-36), the component doc comment (L38-45), the destructured signature with defaults side='bottom'/align='start'/sideOffset=6 (L46-56), the contentRef + pos state (L57-60), the useLayoutEffect compute() flip/align/clamp positioning + resize/scroll listeners (L62-120), the focus-restore effect (L122-131), the Esc + outside-pointerdown effect (L133-157), the `if (!open) return null` guard (L159), the content <div role=dialog> surface (L161-182), and the createPortal(content, document.body) return (L184-185).

Preserved the public contract and state names verbatim: open, onClose, anchorRef, side, align, sideOffset, ariaLabel, children, plus the PopoverAlign ('start'|'end'|'center') and PopoverSide ('bottom'|'top') exported types and the same defaults (side='bottom', align='start', sideOffset=6). The internal `pos` state keeps its exact shape { top; left; resolvedSide } (L58-60). Added only a native-only optional `testID` for test/composition hooks; the DOM-only `className` (L32, L174) becomes `style` (StyleProp<ViewStyle>) layered after the default surface, matching the source's 'append extra classes to the surface' semantics.

Ported the web compute() positioning algorithm (L65-110) 1:1 into a native effect: getBoundingClientRect for the anchor (L70) -> View.measureInWindow(x,y,w,h) producing the same {top,left,right,bottom,width,height} rect; getBoundingClientRect for the content (L71) -> onLayout width/height; window.innerWidth/innerHeight (L72-73) -> Dimensions.get('window'). The margin=8 (L74), the side-flip rule (spaceBelow/spaceAbove, L77-84), the bottom-vs-top top calc (L86-91), the start/end/center left calc (L93-100), and the horizontal + vertical viewport clamps (L102-108) are reproduced character-for-character. Verified by tests: align start top=146/left=50, auto-flip to top=544 when space below is short, align end left=70, align center left=60, horizontal clamp left=192, and a custom sideOffset=20 -> top=160.

Replaced createPortal(children, document.body) (L9, L184) with a transparent React Native <Modal> (animationType='fade', visible={open}) — the native 'portal to the top layer'; children mount only while open, mirroring the web `if (!open) return null` (L159). The web 'render hidden, measure, then show' trick (style top/left ?? -9999 + visibility:hidden until pos, L169-171) is reproduced as top/left = pos?.top/left ?? -9999 with opacity 0 until `pos` resolves, then opacity 1. The content <div role='dialog' aria-label aria-modal='false'> (L162-166) maps to a View with accessibilityViewIsModal + accessibilityLabel={ariaLabel}; the surface classes 'rounded-lg border border-[var(--glass-border)] bg-[var(--surface-1)] shadow-xl' (L174-178) become StyleSheet borderRadius:8 / borderWidth:1 + colors.border / colors.surface / shadows.panel, and the zIndex:60 (L172) is moot under a Modal (it already renders above all). text-[var(--text-primary)] is left to the caller's children (RN has no inheritable text color on a View).

Mapped the DOM event listeners (L114-118, L137-156) to native equivalents: the resize listener -> Dimensions.addEventListener('change', measureAnchor) (re-measures the anchor on rotation/resize); the scroll listener has no analog because a Modal overlay cannot scroll the popover, so it is dropped (documented). The document pointerdown outside-close (L137-143) -> a full-screen backdrop Pressable onPress={onClose}; inside taps land on the content (rendered above the backdrop) so the contentRef.contains / anchorRef.contains guards (L140-141) are structurally satisfied. The keydown Escape close (L144-149) -> Modal onRequestClose (Android back / hardware Esc). The focus-restore effect (L122-131) is preserved verbatim (wasOpenRef + best-effort anchorRef.current?.focus?.() on close) and verified by a test asserting the trigger's focus() fires on the open->closed transition.

Documented native-platform deltas per rule 7: (a) the web is intentionally NOT a focus trap (L40-44, aria-modal='false') whereas RN <Modal> traps focus — an inherent platform difference, kept because Modal is the only faithful portal/outside-close/back-button primitive; (b) anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLElement> -> RefObject<PopoverAnchorHandle | null>, a minimal { measureInWindow; focus? } contract that a plain useRef<View>(null) satisfies structurally; (c) the SSR guards typeof window/document === 'undefined' (L63, L159) have no RN analog and are dropped; (d) the forced-colors high-contrast border/bg overrides (L176) have no RN analog; (e) View.focus() is a no-op on most platforms (meaningful for a TextInput trigger), so focus restoration is best-effort.

Gates run from apps/native and all green: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint .) exit 0; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` 25 suites / 150 tests passed, including the new __tests__/Popover.test.tsx (14 cases: closed no-render, Modal mount, all three align modes, auto-flip, horizontal clamp, custom sideOffset, backdrop close, onRequestClose close, custom testID, focus restore, ariaLabel pass-through). No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, react-dom/createPortal, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported — only React, RN primitives (Modal/Pressable/View/StyleSheet/Dimensions), and the existing apps/native theme tokens (colors, shadows).
